overview_description.description: True3D Labs creates 3D visualization and interactive media solutions for web and live digital experiences. Offerings include design, production, and deployment of real-time 3D scenes, motion graphics, and broadcast-style overlays that integrate with streaming platforms and websites. Services cover asset creation, rendering pipelines, and software tools that support live data-driven graphics, audience engagement elements, and cross-device playback. Capabilities extend to building custom interactives, optimizing 3D content for performance, and managing cloud delivery of media assets. Projects often synchronize visuals with external data feeds, enabling scoreboards, alerts, and dynamic scenes during events. Support involves content updates, technical integration, and testing for scheduled shows and campaigns.
